name: Color & Unwind
summary:
Take a creative break in Color & Unwind. Choose a gallery, point at numbered spaces, and bring each painting to life at your own pace. Enjoy music and narrated stories, save your progress, and revisit your artwork in My Library.

Color in a peaceful park or explore the Moonlit Ship beneath a nighttime sky. Move the coloring screen with your controller grip and arrange your space comfortably. Windowed Portals can be resized and set to follow you or stay anchored.

Color with a friend in a private two-player
